episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.logline: Original public demo written for this prototype: a daughter discovers a forged transfer.
episodes.continuity: Standalone fictional example. This is not Kuku's supplied content.

events.label: MARA (Accusing)
events.text: "You sold our house?"

events.label: ACTION
events.text: Mara slams a signed property transfer onto her brother's desk. The signature bears their mother's name.

events.label: CAMERA
events.text: Close-up of the transfer, then the brother's startled face.

events.label: ELI (Defensive)
events.text: "Someone had to pay for Mother's treatment."

events.label: MARA (Shaken)
events.text: "The hospital says her treatment was paid for last month."

events.label: ELI (Quiet)
events.text: "Then the hospital is lying to you."

events.label: ACTION
events.text: Mara turns the document over. A second signature is hidden beneath a folded corner.

events.label: MARA (Demanding)
events.text: "Who is the witness? Why is the name blacked out?"

events.label: ELI (Threatening)
events.text: "If you uncover that name, Mother will disappear."

events.label: ACTION
events.text: Mara's phone lights up with a call from her mother's number. Eli reaches for it.

events.label: MARA (Alarmed)
events.text: "Why are you afraid of her calling?"

events.label: ELI (Urgent)
events.text: "Do not answer that phone."

events.label: ACTION
events.text: Mara locks the office door and answers on speaker. A stranger is breathing on the other end.

events.label: STRANGER (Low)
events.text: "Ask your brother what he really sold."

events.label: MARA (Horrified)
events.text: "Where is my mother?"

events.label: ACTION
events.text: Eli pulls a key from his pocket and slides it under a locked cabinet.

events.label: ELI (Resigned)
events.text: "She made me promise you would never open it."

events.label: MARA (Defiant)
events.text: "Then she should have told me the truth."

events.label: ACTION
events.text: Mara takes the key. From inside the cabinet comes a single sharp knock.

events.label: MARA (Whispering)
events.text: "Who is in there?"

proposal.title: The Signature Beneath the Fold
proposal.hook: Mara slams a property transfer signed by their supposedly incapacitated mother onto Eli's desk, accusing him of selling their home behind her back.
proposal.cliffhanger: As Mara confronts Eli about a second hidden signature and a blacked-out witness name, her phone rings with a call from her mother's number — and Eli lunges to stop her from answering.
proposal.why: Opens with an explosive accusation and physical evidence, escalates through layered revelations (fake medical bills, forged documents, a mysterious witness), and ends on a visceral cliffhanger: a call from a mother who should be hospitalized, and a brother desperate to silence it. The 35-second runtime packs a complete dramatic arc with a hook that demands resolution.

assessment.hook: "You sold our house?"
assessment.cliffhanger: "If you uncover that name, Mother will disappear."
assessment.unanswered_question: Who is the blacked-out witness, and why does Eli claim uncovering their name will cause their mother to disappear?
assessment.why: The 35-second interval delivers a dense, escalating conflict: a surprise property transfer, contradictory financial claims, a hidden second signature with a redacted witness, and a direct threat tied to the mother's safety, culminating in a live call from the mother's phone as Eli intervenes. Every beat introduces new information that rewrites the previous beat, keeping comprehension high while stakes and tension rise sharply.
risks: Heavy exposition front-loaded into a short window may overwhelm a first-time viewer if visual pacing lags.
Eli's threat ("Mother will disappear") is ambiguous—literal abduction, institutionalization, or metaphorical loss—creating potential confusion about the nature of the stakes.
The final action (Eli reaching for the phone) overlaps the cut; if the next scene doesn't resolve the call immediately, the cliffhanger could feel like a cheat.

proposal.title: What's Behind the Locked Cabinet
proposal.hook: A stranger's voice on Mara's mother's phone warns: 'Ask your brother what he really sold' — then Eli slides a key under a locked cabinet, admitting their mother made him promise Mara would never open it.
proposal.cliffhanger: Mara takes the key and unlocks the cabinet. From inside comes a single sharp knock. She demands: 'Who is in there?'
proposal.why: Picks up at the moment the conspiracy deepens — a stranger on the line, a brother's confession, a mother's enforced silence. The 42-second segment builds claustrophobic tension through a locked room, a hidden key, and a cabinet that answers back, ending on an image that cannot be ignored.
